name: The Crown of Will
summary: With the ogres' defenses weakened, Melisara in Tarren Mill wants the heads of Mug'Thol's three lieutenants, Targ, Muckrake and Glommus, before Mug'Thol himself is dealt with.

sections.title: Sniping at the Leadership
sections.body: Mug'Thol's lieutenants are Targ, Muckrake and Glommus, all loyal to him, though Melisara wonders what could make an ogre loyal. You are to kill all three and bring their heads back to Tarren Mill. After that, only Mug'Thol's own head remains to be taken, crown and all.

sections.title: What Becomes of the Heads
sections.body: Melisara remarks on how foul the ogres smell. Once Mug'Thol's head arrives too, all four will be set on pikes over Alterac, as a reminder to anyone who crosses the Dark Lady.

faq.q: Who gives this part of The Crown of Will?
aliases: who starts the crown of will
where to turn in the crown of will
faq.answer: Melisara, in Tarren Mill, gives it to you and is also the one you bring the heads to.

faq.q: Who are Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus?
faq.answer: They are Mug'Thol's lieutenants, loyal to him. Melisara wants their heads.
The second part of The Crown of Will, in which the ogres' numbers were thinned.
